_comment: Criteria catalog for the 'Criteria Builder' node. Each entry becomes a toggle; toggled-on entries are emitted as 'key: description' lines for the Critic Settings / Vision Judge 'criteria' field. 'default' = the toggle starts ON. 'group' is metadata (ordering / future UI) and is optional. To ADD YOUR OWN without editing this file (survives a git pull), create 'catalog.user.json' next to it with the same {"criteria": [ ... ]} shape; entries there extend this list and override any matching 'key'. Keys must be lowercase [a-z0-9_]; 'extra' and 'criteria_in' are reserved.

criteria.description: overall image quality — matches the intended style, no artifacts, no excess noise, correct proportions, good color reproduction
how accurately the image follows the generation prompt — subjects, attributes, counts and relations are all present and correct
all required limbs present, no extra or missing limbs, correct joint placement, natural and proportional body
hands and fingers — correct finger count, natural shape and pose, no fused, missing or extra digits
face quality — symmetry, natural features, correct eyes and teeth, no distortion, consistent with the intended subject
composition and framing — balanced layout, clear focal point, good use of the frame, no awkward cropping
perspective and geometry — consistent vanishing points and scale, no warped or physically impossible structures
camera angle and camera settings (lens, depth of field, framing) match the intent
lighting — believable direction and intensity, coherent shadows and highlights, matches the described mood
color — pleasing coherent palette, accurate white balance, no oversaturation or unwanted color casts
sharpness and focus — the subject is crisp where intended, no unwanted blur and no over-sharpening halos
level of detail — fine textures and small elements render cleanly, no mushy or smeared areas
background — coherent with the scene, no distracting artifacts, correct depth and separation from the subject
style consistency — one coherent art style throughout, no clashing rendering styles within the image
photorealism — looks like a real photograph, believable materials and skin, no tell-tale AI look (use only for realistic targets)
aesthetic appeal — overall attractiveness and visual impact, tasteful and pleasing to look at
if the prompt requests text — present, character-accurate, correct color/font/size/placement; if the prompt has NO text, give the top score
